card.name: Linking words in opioid treatment text
card.fires_on: Small linking words (such, with, for, and, of) and section-number digits in opioid and buprenorphine label text. They sit right before a treatment, drug or risk phrase.

modes.label: Linking words before treatment
modes.description: Words like such, with, for, and, of come just before a drug name or treatment phrase in opioid-use-disorder text.
modes.example: Advise pregnant women receiving opioid addiction treatment<< with>> buprenorphine and nalox

modes.label: Section numbers
modes.description: A digit in a cross-reference or section number such as 2.9 or 7.4.
